reason: A is the better proposal because Ti/Zr alloying has at least indirect experimental grounding in ductile refractory BCC alloys and it supplies a quantified, baseline-controlled falsification test. Its proposed HCP-like domains and defect-sink mechanism remain speculative—and may conflict with Ti/Zr BCC solubility—whereas B’s unsupported assumption that 5 at.% V will segregate into beneficial ductile defect sinks is even less physically grounded.
